OD-B20-S01-T01.line: Endure, my heart. You endured worse in the cave of the Cyclops.
OD-B20-S01-T01.direction: lie rigid on the oxhide, counting the maids as they pass

OD-B20-S02-T01.line: Father Zeus, if you led me home over dry land and water, give me two signs. Let a voice speak inside the house, and let your thunder speak outside it.
OD-B20-S02-T01.direction: kneel low in the doorway, palms turned up

OD-B20-S01-T02.line: Why do you lie awake, unhappiest of men? This is your house. Your wife is inside it, and the son any man would pray for. What more do you want of me?
OD-B20-S01-T02.direction: stand over him in the dark, unhurried

OD-B20-S01-T03.line: I am with you, and I never leave you. If fifty companies of men stood against us with spears, you would drive off their cattle by morning. Sleep now. I lay it on your eyes myself.
OD-B20-S01-T03.direction: pass a hand across his eyes and close them

OD-B20-S01-T04.line: Artemis, holy lady, put your arrow in my breast tonight, or let a storm take me and drop me where the sea runs out. I dreamed he lay beside me with the face he wore the year he sailed, and I was glad, and it was not a dream but a waking thing.
OD-B20-S01-T04.direction: sit up in the dark bed, hands open in her lap

OD-B20-S02-T02.direction: one clean thunderclap from a cloudless sky

OD-B20-S02-T03.line: Father Zeus, you thundered, and there is no cloud anywhere. Then grant this to a woman at the millstone. Let this be the last meal the suitors ever eat in that hall. My knees are loosened grinding their barley. Let them be finished today.
OD-B20-S02-T03.direction: stop the millstone, straighten, speak up at the roof

OD-B20-S02-T04.direction: rise from the doorway with the beggar's stoop half gone

OD-B20-S03-T01.line: Up, girls. It is Apollo's feast day. Sweep, wet the floor, rinse every cup.
OD-B20-S03-T01.direction: clap twice and drive the maids into the hall

OD-B20-S03-T02.line: Good morning, stranger. Do the men treat you any better today, or is the house still the house it was?
OD-B20-S03-T02.direction: drive the pigs through the gate and clasp the beggar's shoulder

OD-B20-S03-T03.line: Still here, dog? Still working the doorway for scraps?
OD-B20-S03-T03.direction: shove past with the goats, clip the beggar with his shoulder

OD-B20-S03-T04.line: Forgive me, father. My eyes run when I look at you. My master would wear your rags now, if he lives.
OD-B20-S03-T04.direction: take the beggar's hand in both of his, weeping

OD-B20-S03-T05.line: Herdsman, mark what I say, and let the gods hear it. Before you drive your cattle home again, Odysseus will stand in this house, and you will see with your own eyes the suitors killed.
OD-B20-S03-T05.direction: hold his hand and lower the voice

OD-B20-S04-T01.line: Let them plot. A bird flew from the left with a living dove in its claws, and even Amphinomus went pale at it. I will eat at my own table, and no man here will tell me where to sit.
OD-B20-S04-T01.direction: take his seat by the door and set his spear against the pillar

OD-B20-S04-T02.line: The stranger has had his share like the rest of us. Here is a guest-gift from me, worthy of the bath-woman and the servants he keeps company with.
OD-B20-S04-T02.direction: lift an ox hoof from the basket and hurl it

OD-B20-S04-T03.direction: tilt the head aside, the hoof strikes the wall

OD-B20-S04-T04.line: Ctesippus, be glad you missed. If you had struck my guest, my father's spear would be in your belly and your father would be building your tomb instead of your wedding. Not one more insult in this house. I am a boy no longer, and I see everything you do.
OD-B20-S04-T04.direction: stand, spear levelled across the tables

OD-B20-S04-T05.line: Then Agelaus rose and said the prince should send his mother out to be married at last. And Telemachus answered that he would never drive his own mother from her door against her will, and the suitors had no answer to that.
OD-B20-S04-T05.direction: step forward at the edge of the hall

OD-B20-S05-T01.direction: unseen, she strikes laughter into every suitor at once

OD-B20-S05-T02.line: They laugh with jaws that will not close, and the meat they lift is dripping blood, and the tears run down their faces while they laugh.
OD-B20-S05-T02.direction: walk the line of laughing men

OD-B20-S05-T03.line: Night. Night on all of you.
OD-B20-S05-T03.direction: stand and back away from the table, staring past them

OD-B20-S05-T04.line: Your heads are wrapped in darkness and your knees are gone. The walls are running with blood, the porch is full of ghosts going down to the dark, and the sun has died out of the sky. Laugh. I am going out of this house while its door still opens.
OD-B20-S05-T04.direction: walk out through their laughter without turning

OD-B20-S05-T05.direction: meet his father's eyes across the hall and hold them

OD-B21-S01-T01.direction: set the thought of the bow in the queen's mind

OD-B21-S01-T02.direction: guide her hand to the storeroom key, the doors groan open

OD-B21-S01-T03.direction: the queen sits, the bow across her knees, and weeps

OD-B21-S01-T04.line: Two maids carry in the chest of iron, and the axes are set down ringing on the floor of the hall.
OD-B21-S01-T04.direction: clear a lane down the middle of the room

OD-B21-S02-T01.line: Hear me, lords. Here is the great bow of Odysseus. Whoever strings it with his own hands and sends an arrow clean through all twelve axes, I will go with that man, and leave this house I came to as a bride.
OD-B21-S02-T01.direction: lay the bow down before them, veil drawn

OD-B21-S02-T02.direction: look at the bow, turn aside, weep openly

OD-B21-S02-T03.line: Take your crying outside, you fools. You are spoiling her heart.

OD-B21-S02-T04.direction: trench the axes in one line, then heave three times at the bow

OD-B21-S02-T05.line: The fourth pull would have strung it. But his father moved his head, once, and the boy set the bow down and called himself weak.
OD-B21-S02-T05.direction: mark the small nod from the doorway

OD-B21-S03-T01.line: I cannot bend it. Let another try. But I tell you, this bow will take the life and the breath out of the best men here, and better to die than live on failing at what we came for.
OD-B21-S03-T01.direction: hand the bow away and sit down heavily

OD-B21-S03-T02.line: One after another they took it up, and braced it, and sweated, and set it down again, and the bow did not move.
OD-B21-S03-T02.direction: pass the bow along the line of chairs

OD-B21-S03-T03.direction: build up the fire, bring a cake of fat, grease the bow

OD-B21-S03-T04.line: It is not the marriage. It is the shame.
OD-B21-S03-T04.direction: fling the warmed bow down, hands shaking

OD-B21-S03-T05.line: Enough. It is Apollo's day. Pour the wine, and we finish this tomorrow.
OD-B21-S03-T05.direction: take the bow and prop it against the doorpost

OD-B21-S04-T01.line: If Odysseus walked through that gate this hour, which side would you two stand on?
OD-B21-S04-T01.direction: follow them into the yard, out of earshot

OD-B21-S04-T02.line: Then look. Here is the scar the boar gave me on Parnassus. I am Odysseus. I am home, in the twentieth year, and I stand in front of you.
OD-B21-S04-T02.direction: pull back the rag from the thigh

OD-B21-S04-T03.line: They took him in their arms and kissed his head and his hands, and he kissed theirs, and the sun would have gone down on their weeping if he had not stopped it.
OD-B21-S04-T03.direction: close the three of them together in the yard

OD-B21-S04-T04.line: No more tears. Eumaeus, when they shout you down, carry the bow to me anyway and put it in my hands. Philoetius, bar the courtyard gate and lash it fast. And tell Eurycleia to lock the women in their rooms and let no one out, whatever they hear.
OD-B21-S04-T04.direction: grip each man by the arm in turn

OD-B21-S05-T01.line: Hear me, lords. Let me put my hands on the bow, only to learn whether any strength is left in these arms, or whether the road has eaten it all.
OD-B21-S05-T01.direction: shuffle forward from the doorway, palms open

OD-B21-S05-T02.line: Then they roared at him, and under the anger ran a colder thing, that a beggar might do what their hands could not.
OD-B21-S05-T02.direction: turn the whole room toward the door

OD-B21-S05-T03.line: Let the stranger have the bow. He is a guest in my house, and no guest is refused here. And if he strings it, I will give him a cloak and a tunic, a spear, and a sword, and send him wherever his heart wants to go.

OD-B21-S05-T04.line: Mother, the bow is mine to give, and no man in Ithaca will overrule me in my own house. Go up to your room and your loom. The talking here belongs to the men.
OD-B21-S05-T04.direction: stand between her and the hall until she goes

OD-B21-S05-T05.direction: carry the bow through the shouting and lay it in the beggar's hands

OD-B21-S06-T01.line: Bolt them. Nobody comes out, whatever you hear.
OD-B21-S06-T01.direction: shut the women's doors and set the bar

OD-B21-S06-T02.direction: lash the courtyard gate shut with a ship's cable

OD-B21-S06-T03.direction: turn the bow slowly, checking horn and grip, ignoring the jeers

OD-B21-S06-T04.line: The doors are shut. The cable is knotted. Every way out of that hall is closed, and the men inside it are still laughing.
OD-B21-S06-T04.direction: seal the room from the edge of the light

OD-B21-S07-T01.direction: seated, string the bow in one easy motion

OD-B21-S07-T02.direction: pluck the string, a swallow's note fills the hall

OD-B21-S07-T03.line: It is time, son of Laertes. I have set my sign on the day.

OD-B21-S07-T04.direction: belt on the sword, take up the spear, stand at his father's shoulder

OD-B21-S07-T05.direction: nock, draw from the chair, the arrow clears all twelve axes

OD-B21-S07-T06.line: Telemachus, the stranger sitting in your hall has not disgraced you. I did not miss the mark, and the bow did not wear me out. Now it is the hour for supper, while there is still light, and after supper there is other sport in this house.
OD-B21-S07-T06.direction: rise from the chair, arrows loose at his feet
